tool_schemas.name: execute_command
tool_schemas.description: Executes the provided shell command in the current session working directory and returns the command’s stdout/stderr along with execution status, enforcing the supplied timeout (default 30 seconds). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `command` is empty or `timeout` is not a positive integer, and TIMEOUT if execution exceeds the timeout. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to run terminal commands for the session and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if command execution limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get_command_history
tool_schemas.description: Returns the most recent command execution records for the current session, up to `count` entries, in reverse-chronological order; results are not paged and are limited to the requested count. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `count` is not a positive integer. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to view session audit history.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_directory
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current working directory path for the session. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to access the session terminal state. Raises NOT_FOUND if the session terminal state is unavailable or has been cleared.

tool_schemas.name: change_directory
tool_schemas.description: Sets the session’s current working directory to `path` and returns the updated directory information. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `path` is empty, NOT_FOUND if the target directory does not exist, and CONFLICT if `path` exists but is not a directory. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to change the session working directory.

tool_schemas.name: list_directory
tool_schemas.description: Lists files and subdirectories for `path` (or the current working directory when `path` is null) and returns the directory entries; results are returned as a single, unpaged list. Raises NOT_FOUND if the directory does not exist and CONFLICT if the resolved `path` is not a directory. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to read directory contents.

tool_schemas.name: write_file
tool_schemas.description: Writes `content` to `path` using `mode` (`overwrite` replaces the file; `append` adds to the end) and returns operation details. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `path`/`content` are empty or `mode` is not one of `overwrite` or `append`, and NOT_FOUND if the parent directory does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if `path` refers to a directory or the write cannot be applied due to file state, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to write files.

tool_schemas.name: read_file
tool_schemas.description: Reads file content from `path` and returns it either as raw text or, when `as_json` is true, parsed JSON; when `start_row` and/or `end_row` are provided, returns only the inclusive 0-based line range. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if row parameters are negative, inconsistent (e.g., `end_row` < `start_row`), or if JSON parsing fails when `as_json` is true. Raises NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist, CONFLICT if `path` is not a regular file, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to read files.

tool_schemas.name: insert_file_content
tool_schemas.description: Inserts `content` into the file at `path` at the specified 0-based `row` or at each row in `rows` and returns operation details; if neither `row` nor `rows` is provided, the request is rejected. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if both `row` and `rows` are provided, if any row index is negative, or if required fields are missing. Raises NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist, CONFLICT if `path` is not a regular file or insertion cannot be applied due to file state, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to modify files.

tool_schemas.name: delete_file_content
tool_schemas.description: Deletes content from the file at `path` at the specified 0-based `row` or at each row in `rows`; when `substring` is provided, only that substring within the targeted row(s) is removed, and the endpoint returns operation details. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if both `row` and `rows` are provided, if any row index is negative, or if `substring` is provided but not found in the targeted row(s). Raises NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist, CONFLICT if `path` is not a regular file or the delete cannot be applied due to file state, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to modify files.

tool_schemas.name: update_file_content
tool_schemas.description: Replaces content in the file at `path` at the specified 0-based `row` or at each row in `rows` with `content`; when `substring` is provided, only the matching substring in the targeted row(s) is replaced, and the endpoint returns operation details. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if both `row` and `rows` are provided, if any row index is negative, or if `substring` is provided but not found in the targeted row(s). Raises NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist, CONFLICT if `path` is not a regular file or the update cannot be applied due to file state, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to modify files.

tool_schemas.name: update_session_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions the current session lifecycle state by updating `status` (active↔suspended, active/suspended→closed). Rejects illegal transitions with CONFLICT and rejects any attempt to modify a closed session with FORBIDDEN.

status.description: Target session status; must be a valid lifecycle transition from the current status.

tool_schemas.name: get_command_execution
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single command execution record by id for the current session, including status and captured output when available. Raises NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist (or is not visible to the caller) and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access session audit history.

tool_schemas.name: list_command_executions
tool_schemas.description: Lists command execution records for the current session in reverse-chronological order with pagination and optional status filtering. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid pagination parameters and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access session audit history.

status.description: Filter results to a single execution status.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1..200).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call; when provided, returns results after this cursor.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_command_execution
tool_schemas.description: Cancels a queued or running command execution by id and returns the updated execution record. Raises CONFLICT if the execution is already in a terminal state, NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to control command execution in the session.

metadata.name: Terminal Controller
metadata.description: This backend stores per-session terminal state (current working directory) and an auditable log of shell commands and file operations executed through the API. Primary workflows include executing commands with timeouts, navigating directories, listing directories, and reading/writing/modifying files
